---
title: "Additional Citation Options"
---

## Ordinary citations

Native citation syntax remains available:

- Narrative: @bergelson_1996
- Parenthetical: [@bergelson_1996]
- Suppress author: [-@bergelson_1996]
- Locator: [@bergelson_1996, sec. 1]

## Extra presentation options

- Remove the round delimiters: [@bergelson_1996]{.no-paren}
- Remove the outer round delimiters of a parenthetical citation:
  [[@bergelson_1996]]{.no-paren}
- Remove the parenthesised segment of a narrative citation:
  [@bergelson_1996]{.remove-paren}
- Keep surrounding text and formatting:
  [See **@bergelson_1996** for the discussion]{.no-paren}.

These classes edit punctuation. They do not select CSL author/year fields.
Applying `.remove-paren` to an entirely parenthetical citation removes all
of its visible text; the bibliography entry remains.

## Citation in a definition heading

::: {#def-example}
## [[@bergelson_1996, sec. 1]]{.no-paren}

This is an authoring demonstration, not a mathematical definition.
:::
